purpose: Teach: 三宮/松平/トゥ/吉井/岩本/半田/栗山/入江

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、神戸三宮の地震被害復興史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered the Kobe-Sannomiya earthquake recovery history in your thesis, didn't you?
lines.style: Calm, measured opening. A statement framed as gentle confirmation. Steady eye contact, the tone of someone who has read your work and is inviting you to discuss it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、徳川松平家の系譜研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I actually wrote about the genealogy of the Tokugawa and Matsudaira families.
lines.style: Quiet correction, slightly embarrassed but honest. Speaks with care, as if each word matters. No defensiveness—just the truth of what he actually did.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、英語のトゥ、つまり「to」音素の音韻論を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you examined the phonology of the English 'tu' sound—the 'to' phoneme—in your thesis, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle, reflective tone. A patient teacher checking in again, genuinely curious about where he actually went. Warm but precise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、政治家吉井英勝氏の議会活動研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on the parliamentary activities and political work of Diet member Yoshii Hidekatsu.
lines.style: Direct and careful. A second quiet correction. He's used to this pattern now—speaking without apology, just factual. Steady voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、岩本徹三のゼロ戦操縦の戦記を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered Iwamoto Tetsuzo's combat record—his Zero fighter piloting experience—in your thesis, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, patient. The rhythm of someone genuinely trying to understand, not testing. Open curiosity underneath the gentle probe.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、電気工学の半田、つまり半田付けの工学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I actually wrote about the engineering of soldering—the electrical engineering applications of solder joints.
lines.style: Another soft correction. Unflustered. He's finding his rhythm with this conversation now. Clear and self-contained.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、野球の栗山英樹監督の采配研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you examined baseball manager Kuriyama Hideki's strategic decisions in your thesis, didn't you?
lines.style: Reflective, almost gentle in its persistence. The tone of a teacher who is listening more than testing. Warm curiosity.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、海岸の入江、つまり入江地形の海洋学研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about inlet formations and coastal geography—the oceanography of cove topography.
lines.style: Final correction, delivered with quiet confidence. He's settled into honesty. Clear, complete, without self-doubt. A gentle closing.
